topic: Form 15G/15H are gone: nil-tax savers need Form 121 or 10% TDS can be cut from FD interest
experiment: EXPLOIT news-list on a rule most savers missed (1 Apr change); send target is parents with FDs.
caption:
Still giving your bank Form 15G or 15H? Those were replaced on 1 April 2026.

Under the new income tax law, 15G and 15H became a single declaration: Form 121.
If your total tax for the year is nil, it asks the bank not to cut TDS from your FD interest.
Old declarations don't carry over, so give a fresh Form 121 to each bank. Without it, 10% TDS can be cut.

Has your bank asked you for Form 121 yet?

Sources: two tax explainers on Form 121 (Jun 2026 and current) and a personal-finance deadline checklist (1 Oct 2026).
